newsitem.title: USA: High Plains Wheat - Warm weather graces Plains.
newsitem.headline: High Plains Wheat - Warm weather graces Plains.

text.p: Dry, warm weather arrived in the central and southern U.S. Plains, boosting hopes that some long-delayed planting might finally be undertaken, grain dealers said Monday.
"We're probably going to see some clear, dry and warm weather, so we might get some additional wheat planted and emerged in southeast Kansas," one Oklahoma dealer said.

Plantings in southeast Kansas have been delayed by rains throughout October and November. The Kansas Department of Agricultural Statistics said last week that little additional wheat acreage is expected to be seeded this fall.
Meanwhile, basis bids for hard red winter wheat were mostly unchanged, although bids at some mill locations in eastern Kansas were raised.
